name: io.github.microhenrio/openocd-mcp
title: OpenOCD Debugger
description: Debug microcontrollers via OpenOCD: flash, breakpoints, memory, registers and variables.

environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to force read-only mode; optional.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Start OpenOCD and connect to the target.

tools.name: halt
tools.description: Halt the CPU.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume CPU execution.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset the target.

tools.name: step
tools.description: Single-step the CPU.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Return CPU status and program counter.

tools.name: start_openocd
tools.description: Start the OpenOCD process without connecting.

tools.name: stop_openocd
tools.description: Stop the OpenOCD process.

tools.name: flash_write
tools.description: Flash a firmware ELF/BIN/HEX file.

tools.name: flash_info
tools.description: Show flash bank information.

tools.name: flash_erase_sector
tools.description: Erase a flash sector (requires allow_flash_erase permission).

tools.name: load_elf
tools.description: Load an ELF file for symbol and DWARF type resolution.

tools.name: read_variable
tools.description: Read a variable by name from the ELF symbol table.

tools.name: write_variable
tools.description: Write a variable by name.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: List all variables found in the ELF symbol table.

tools.name: watch_variables
tools.description: Sample one or more variables repeatedly without halting the CPU, returning a text table. For an auto-refreshing GUI window instead, use the separate 'openocd-watch' console script — it is not reachable as an MCP tool call, but an assistant with its own shell access may launch it as a background process; otherwise tell the user to run it themselves.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read raw memory at an address.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Write a value to a memory address.

tools.name: read_registers
tools.description: Read all CPU registers.

tools.name: read_register
tools.description: Read a single CPU register.

tools.name: write_register
tools.description: Write a CPU register.

tools.name: load_svd
tools.description: Load a CMSIS-SVD file for peripheral register resolution.

tools.name: read_peripheral
tools.description: Read all registers of a peripheral and decode their bitfields.

tools.name: read_peripheral_register
tools.description: Read a peripheral register by name (e.g. GPIOA.MODER).

tools.name: write_peripheral_register
tools.description: Write a peripheral register by name.

tools.name: list_peripheral_registers
tools.description: List all registers of a peripheral.

tools.name: add_breakpoint
tools.description: Set a hardware or software breakpoint at an address.

tools.name: remove_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove a breakpoint.

tools.name: add_conditional_breakpoint
tools.description: Set a breakpoint that halts only when a TCL condition is true.

tools.name: remove_conditional_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove a conditional breakpoint.

tools.name: list_breakpoints
tools.description: List all active breakpoints.

tools.name: remove_all_breakpoints
tools.description: Remove all breakpoints.

tools.name: add_watchpoint
tools.description: Set a hardware watchpoint that halts on read/write/access to an address.

tools.name: remove_watchpoint
tools.description: Remove a watchpoint.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Set session configuration (interface, target, ELF, SVD, transport).

tools.name: show_config
tools.description: Show active configuration and permissions.

tools.name: set_permissions
tools.description: Set safety permissions (read_only, allow_flash, allow_memory_write, etc.).

tools.name: install_openocd
tools.description: Download and cache the OpenOCD binary for the current platform.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a raw OpenOCD TCL command (requires allow_raw_command permission).
